verdict.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly claims Workers fit existing workflows (Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code, any framework) with no proprietary tools, and documents framework choice across React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro and more. However, creating, developing and deploying Workers runs through Cloudflare's own Wrangler CLI and create-cloudflare scaffolder, though these are open source in workers-sdk. A community user also notes that platform-specific KV/D1 bindings make switching hard, so workflows are not entirely vendor-neutral. Missing for 10: documented Git/CI integration details beyond a marketing line, a deploy path that does not depend on Wrangler, independent hands-on corroboration of lock-in-free workflows.
